name: multi-select
purpose: Select control specialised for choosing many options from a list. The trigger field mirrors `Input`'s visual API (size, hover/focus/filled/disabled/invalid/required states) so a MultiSelect sits next to other form fields without visual drift. The dropdown panel is teleported to `body` and anchored to the trigger by the shared `usePlacement` composable — no `@floating-ui` runtime. Every option row carries a checkbox indicator (the `Checkbox` webkit component), optionally a leading slot/icon and a trailing tag. Search and "Create new" footer are exposed as slots on `<MultiSelectContent>`. Since spec v4 the trigger can also show the selection as removable chips (`kind="chips"`, capped by `chipLimit` with a `+N more` chip), take typed text to filter the options in place (`searchable`), offer an `Add "…"` row for a typed value that matches no option (`allowCustom`, emits `create`), and render its own loading, error and empty list states (`loading`, `error`, `emptyText`) — the same vocabulary as `combobox`. Unlike `Select` (which toggles between single and multi via a `multiple` prop), MultiSelect is multi-only: `modelValue` is always an array and the indicator is always a checkbox. Aligned with Figma frame `3899:29362` (options panel). The trigger reuses the `Input`/`Select` trigger visuals.
useWhen: Choosing several values from a long list (regions, tags, permissions) in a compact field.
A filter whose selected values stay editable from the same dropdown.
Grouped options with icons or trailing tags, optionally with search.
Tagging a record with labels people pick or type (`kind="chips"` + `searchable` + `allowCustom`).
Options fetched from a server as the person types (`searchable`, `:filter="false"`, `@search`, `loading`, `error`).
avoidWhen: Only one value may be chosen → use `select`.
A labelled form field with helper/error text → put it (or `select` with `multiple`) inside a `field`.
A handful of options that fit on screen → use a horizontal `field` with a `checkbox` for each.
The user builds a subset and needs the chosen and remaining items side by side → use `pick-list`.
Free-form tags with no list of options to pick from → use `tag-editor`.
related: field` — wraps this control with its label, description and error; it hands the trigger its id and state.
pick-list` — dual-list transfer for building larger subsets.
checkbox` — the indicator every option row renders.
combobox` — single-value field with typed text; `searchable`, `allowCustom`, `filter`, `loading` and `emptyText` share its meaning.
bestPractices: modelValue` is always an array; start it as `[]`, never `null`.
Pass `displayValue` to summarise long selections (e.g. "3 regions") instead of a list that overflows the trigger.
Keep each option's `value` stable and unique; selection is matched by value.

Put a search input in the `search` slot and a create action in the `footer` slot of `MultiSelect.Content` — or set `searchable` (and `allowCustom`) to type in the trigger itself; do not combine the two.
With `kind="chips"`, set `chipLimit` when the field sits in a dense row; leave it `0` in a form so every chip wraps and stays removable.
create` only reports the typed value: add the new option to your list and its value to the model in the handler.
For a server-side search, set `:filter="false"`, fetch on `search`, and drive `loading` and `error` from the request.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger placeholder shown when no option is selected.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects trigger height (small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px) matching `Input`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger and prevents opening; applies disabled tokens.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the field read-only; the current selection is visible but the dropdown cannot open.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required; sets `aria-required` on the trigger. Visual indicator (asterisk) is owned by the wrapping form-field, not by this component.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies the invalid border + ring tokens and sets `aria-invalid` on the trigger.

props.name: displayValue
props.doc: Custom formatter used by the trigger to render the selected labels; receives the current `modelValue` array.

props.name: name
props.doc: Form field name. Set, the root renders one hidden input per selected value so a native `form` and `FormData` submit every selection under that name; `required` then adds a hidden required proxy that blocks an empty submit, and `disabled` leaves the values out.

props.name: kind
props.doc: How the trigger shows the selection: `summary` joins the labels (or `displayValue`), `chips` renders one removable chip per value.

props.name: chipLimit
props.doc: With `kind="chips"`, the most chips shown before a `+N more` chip; `0` shows every chip and wraps.

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Types in the trigger: the text filters the options, `Backspace` in an empty field removes the last value.

props.name: filter
props.doc: With `searchable`, hides the options whose label does not contain the typed text. Turn off when the server filters on `search`.

props.name: allowCustom
props.doc: With `searchable`, offers typed text that matches no option as an `Add "…"` row that emits `create`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows the loading row in place of the options while they are fetched.

props.name: error
props.doc: Message shown in place of the options when they failed to load; empty shows the options.

props.name: emptyText
props.doc: Text of the list when no option is visible. Empty uses the locale catalog.

events.name: search
events.notes: The typed text, on each keystroke (`searchable`), and `''` when the panel closes and the text is cleared. Value event: no DOM event.

events.name: create
events.notes: The `Add "…"` row was activated (`allowCustom`), by click or by `Enter` in the field or on the row; `value` is the trimmed typed text. The typed text is cleared; the consumer adds the option and the value.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Composition slot; receives `<MultiSelectTrigger>` and `<MultiSelectContent>` (and the option tree inside it).
